text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japanese Derby has finally 
arrived. Matikanefukukitaru is burning 
with motivation.

Matikanefukukitaru, claiming she has 
performed every possible ward against 
misfortune, confidently replied that she 
wouldn't be swallowed by the demons of the 
Derby.

And so, vowing to give it everything she 
had, she headed out toward the race.
